findings.claim: ChimeraTool's own help document states it has only two distributors (GsmEasy, GsmServer) and that resellers can only buy credits from them, minimum 20,000 credits per purchase.
findings.excerpt: We have direct contracts with them exclusively, so resellers can only buy credits from them, at the set price.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Confirms the Round-3 search-snippet quote verbatim. Under Chimera's model HalabTech (a listed reseller) must source credits from a distributor, so an intermediate supplier exists for Chimera.
findings.notes: Preceding sentence verbatim: 'Distributor: We have two distributors currently: GsmEasy and GsmServer.' Also: 'you have to purchase a minimum of 20 000 credits from any of our Distributors'; resellers buy at a fixed 8% discount; status lapses if <20,000 CRD bought every 4 months.

findings.direction: ChimeraTool -> B2B wholesale (GsmServer, GsmEasy) -> B2C resellers (incl. HalabTech) -> end users
findings.claim: Chimera's licensing policy names GsmServer and GsmEasy as its only B2B wholesale resellers and says B2C resellers may sell only to end users, not to each other.
findings.excerpt: Our B2C resellers can be found on the following website: https://chimeratool.com/en/resellers Only end users can buy from them, as they cannot sell between themselves.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Explains why HalabTech's current Chimera services are labelled '[NOT FOR WEB OWNER]'. It also conflicts with HalabTech's 2022 'Chimera [Reseller/ Distributor Package]' (see C-06).
findings.notes: Policy text: 'We do not intend to expand our list of resellers, who are currently: GsmServer, GsmEasy'.

findings.direction: ChimeraTool lists HalabTech as a B2C reseller
findings.claim: Of the 136 cards on the live resellers page, only 3 carry the 'Distributor' label (GsmEasy, GsmServer, 'Unlock.eu API Upgrade and Extend'). The HALABTECH card has no Distributor label.
findings.excerpt: ### HALABTECH ... Contact Person HALABTECH ... Web server.halabtech.com ... E-mail info@halabtech.com ... Reseller Shop
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Refines the brief: ChimeraTool lists HalabTech as a reseller only, not as a distributor. Adds a third live distributor (Unlock.eu) even though the docs still say the 'circle of distributors will not be expanded'.
findings.notes: Unlock.eu card: contact 'Mr. Thomas', phone +86075528283361, WhatsApp 008618688344425, Telegram/WeChat 'chimeracredit', label 'Distributor'. HalabTech card lists countries DE, IQ, SY, LB, TR (+4) and payment methods Maestro, MasterCard, PayPal, Skrill, Visa.

findings.excerpt: HALABTECH (reseller) Country Germany, Iraq, Lebanon, Syria, Turkey City GLOBAL Contact person Hosam
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Shows HalabTech has been reseller-tier, not distributor-tier, with Chimera since at least January 2023.

findings.claim: The two-distributor, resellers-buy-only-from-distributors rule was already in force in November 2021 (with a 10% discount and EUR pricing).
findings.excerpt: Distributor: We have two distributors currently: GsmEasy and GsmServer.
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Shows the policy has been stable from 2021 to 2026. It therefore covered HalabTech's 2022 Chimera wholesale packages.

findings.entity: GsmEasy / GsmServer (Chimera distributors) - identity of HalabTech's source unknown
findings.claim: In January 2022 and December 2022 HalabTech sold 'Chimera Credit & Activation' reseller packages at Chimera's 20,000-credit distributor minimum. Chimera says only its distributors sell at that tier, so HalabTech's Chimera stock must have come through a distributor.
findings.excerpt: Chimera Credit & Activation (Min 20000 Credits) [Reseller Package] Instant $ 0.101
findings.supports_or_contradicts: Strong evidence that an intermediate supplier exists for Chimera, per the vendor's distributor-only rule. Which distributor it is remains UNKNOWN. The 2022 packages contradict Chimera's rule that B2C resellers cannot sell to each other.
findings.notes: The Chimera reseller package was gone by the 2024-09-10 capture (Octoplus too), and today's catalog has no '[Reseller/ Distributor Package]' groups at all. Current Chimera services are tagged '[NOT FOR WEB OWNER]'. Unlock.eu is a third, newer distributor candidate.

findings.claim: HalabTech's catalog had a group named 'GsmServer Products' (Boot-Loader v2.0 activation, GB Key, Smart Clip packs) in Jan 2022, Dec 2022 and Sep 2024. It is absent from the October 2026 catalog.
findings.excerpt: GsmServer Products | Boot-Loader 2.0 Activation Code (100 days, 7 GB) | GB Key Act1 | Pack 4 Activation for Smart Clip
findings.supports_or_contradicts: First catalog-level hint that GsmServer supplied HalabTech, not only resold it. It predates GsmServer's Oct 2022 listing of Halabtech packs. A supplier name used as a group label is a lead, not proof.
findings.notes: Boot-Loader v2.0 activation codes are sold on gsmserver.com (e.g., /en/boot-loader-v2-0-activation-code-100-days-3-gb). The group no longer exists, so no current catalog group is affected.

new_leads: Unlock.eu ('Unlock.eu API Upgrade and Extend', Shenzhen, Mr. Thomas, Telegram/WeChat 'chimeracredit') is a third live Chimera distributor and a candidate source for HalabTech's Chimera credits.
HalabTech contact person 'Hosam' (Chimera listing, 2023-01-11) and WhatsApp +905300229173 (DFT Pro listing, 2022-05-11) are new identifiers.

The 'GsmServer Products' group (Boot-Loader v2.0, GB Key, Smart Clip) existed in HalabTech's catalog from at least Jan 2022 to Sep 2024. A 2025 Wayback capture would show when it was dropped, and GsmServer's Dhru API product names could be compared with HalabTech's.

In 2022 HalabTech sold '[Reseller/ Distributor Package]' groups for Chimera (20k), Octoplus (500 cr), Z3x, Infinity (5000 cr), DFT Agent Panel, Cheetah, Xiaomi King and others. The tiers show HalabTech's wholesale role; check each vendor's distributor rules.
Ameer Tool vendor GSMUNBRICK (Mahmoud Takieldeen, +963 992803439) is a Syrian vendor with HalabTech as its sole named worldwide distributor. Check for closer ties.
'RFT Loader' group (7 services) may be a Rapid Flash Tool product; verify on rapidflashtool.com.

Downstream candidates using HalabTech's exact service strings: fix4gsm.com, NCK Shop (shop.futuelink.com), iphoneunlock.org, gsmgenesis.com, wassim-gsmserver.com; WARD Server (Jordan) resells HalabTech subscriptions.
Easy-Firmware/Easy-Unlocker (+9647511889867) is both the EFT vendor and a DFT Pro distributor, making it the most direct EFT source candidate.
